plainName: V-start and gliding on one skate
description: Skaters line up in two or three lines on the goal line. Each one does a V-start (toes turned out), glides on one skate to centre, takes a few quick strides and glides to the far boards. Come back gliding on the other skate. Four times each.
steps: V-start, then glide on one skate to centre.
Three or four quick strides, then glide to the far boards.
Come back the same way, gliding on the other skate.
Next skater goes when you reach the blue line.

focus.why: A strong start and balance on one skate.

source.label: Hockey Canada U9 Plan 02 · skills 1.3.02, 1.1.07
source.note: Combines the plan's Glide on One Skate with its Front V-Start, which is how the glide drill begins. We show two lines; the plan says to split into groups.
